headline: Onida Electronics appoints Rajan Vaidya as independent director
summary: Onida Electronics Limited has announced the appointment of Rajan Vaidya as an Additional and Independent Director of the company, effective November 14, 2026. The filing was submitted to the stock exchanges as part of corporate governance updates. Independent directors provide objective oversight on company boards and audit committees. For Indian retail investors, routine board changes of micro-cap companies have minimal immediate impact on stock price or earnings.
why_it_matters: Routine board changes rarely shift micro-cap stock prices.
